distinctDelta.existing: Current nethack_fieldcraft.assay and trial identify one fixed reed oil from a successful useful observation; typed inference knowledge and hidden situation truth already exist.
distinctDelta.missing: A committed inconclusive observation plus independently earned classification/catalogue evidence constrains the remaining identities and changes a later use/avoidance decision. Current knowledge storage alone does not implement that inference consumer.
distinctDelta.reservationExclusions: ALL19 work, artifact/causal-story modules, existing fieldcraft vial/dog/knife IDs, Eda lessons and all shared integration remain reserved to their actual owners.

originalTransfer.source: An owned unknown potion and previously exposed polarity/known kinds support the exception.
originalTransfer.proposal: One explicitly accepted finite survey-sample situation declares a closed four-wash catalogue, two conserving and two stripping kinds. Four generic sample labels have a stable private mapping; each has two real doses. The player obtains one actual fragile charcoal rubbing through paid local exploration. No stock on reopen.

originalTransfer.source: Throw, drink, detect, cancel or retain stock are distinct paid/risky choices.
originalTransfer.proposal: Classify a chosen sample using a real assay slip and effort, or spend one dose on a glazed chip. An inconclusive harmless release alone leaves several identities possible. Stripping classification plus harmless release singles out bleaching wash in the declared closed catalogue.

originalTransfer.source: Accepted throw deletes one potion and ends a turn; accepted detection/drinking consumes another actual potion.
originalTransfer.proposal: Classification spends one owned diagnostic slip, one native stamina and two played minutes. A chip test spends one dose, one native stamina and one played minute. Cancel before commitment spends nothing; cancelled supported timed work returns exact reservations. A completed inconclusive test keeps the paid costs spent.

originalTransfer.source: Evidence-qualified identification sets the kind table even though the thrown sample is destroyed. Bad identity then reaches drink confirmation; dangerous drinking instead applies its status.
originalTransfer.proposal: Store the actual negative test and classification as separate caused observations, then derive only player-supported candidates. Write interpreted/understood knowledge with inference attribution only when unique. The public quote shows evidence and candidate labels, never private truth.

originalTransfer.source: The consumed sample stays consumed; known kind information changes later named use and avoidance.
originalTransfer.proposal: One remaining fixative dose plus the unique rubbing becomes one preserved native rubbing. A separate delivery transfers that exact product to the existing local buyer and five actual buyer coins to the player. Applying bleaching wash to the rubbing instead spends both and leaves a spoiled rubbing with no payout. Read-only deduction preserves remaining doses; no free re-test, reroll, recipe reward or duplicate receipt.

limits: Durable negative observations, candidate display and recomputation after later classification are original extensions. Brogue evaluates the evidence at splash/identify time; this is not a claim that it stores/replays a negative-test ledger.

originalTransfer.source: Recipe accepts exactly three declared seed inputs; same-species Stormvine yields an identified Levitation potion at zero alchemy energy. Mixed species can produce a different potion after all three seeds are spent.
originalTransfer.proposal: Opt into one finite original side-culvert scene in the existing home realm. Declare three supported local nodes and an actual trap, two latch states and one owner-held cache parcel. Obtain three finite authored reed seeds and an existing owned Empty bench vial, plus the already acquired field.focus method. No free energy or menu provisioning.

originalTransfer.source: One Levitation potion can provide20 temporary flight or be consumed in the4-energy exotic conversion to StormClouds.
originalTransfer.proposal: Brew one base infusion (three seeds+one empty vial, one stamina, three played minutes). Use it for one actual personal-bypass condition consumed by crossing, leaving the trap for later visitors; or refine it into one rain-wash vial.

originalTransfer.source: AlchemyScene displays energy affordability, then actual combine consumes toolkit/global energy before brew; PotionToExotic spends one base potion. Rain throwing spends a real item and time. Wand casting requires charge and normally later debits one charge after effect. These source sequences do not prove durable atomicity.
originalTransfer.proposal: Refine spends the actual base vial and field.focus use{output:1,control:1}: with the current policy this is two reserve and one strain, plus three played minutes. Rain use spends one vial, one stamina and one minute, returning only one empty container. A charged-tool attempt consumes one actual induction-charge item or exact device charge once, whether its supported effect succeeds or causes self-injury.

originalTransfer.source: Rain creates finite clouds. On allowed terrain setCellToWater(true,cell) changes terrain and removes the trap record; custom terrain can veto, and pits/wells take another throw path. Lightning later reads actual water: arc distance2 instead of1, wet main target removes multi-target dilution, and adjacent caster can take half damage.
originalTransfer.proposal: Rain permanently sets the declared local ground to wet and the same trap to broken, never a temporary actor cooling flag. A bounded node/circuit resolver consumes those facts: dry contact reaches only the first latch; wet supported contact reaches the connected second latch. A caster at the adjacent node suffers two actual native HP loss; at the declared remote stand no self-hit. This finite graph/health rule is original, not a generic grid/thermal/combat replacement.

originalTransfer.source: Cloud volume can expire while changed terrain/trap state remains in the serialized Level map/traps; later water flags rebuild from terrain. Charge and injury remain spent.
originalTransfer.proposal: One supported crossing and actually opened cache transfer the one real owner-held parcel to native player inventory; later visitors see the same wet/broken/open site. A source-supported personal bypass can cross while its condition is live but does not remove the trap or open an untouched second latch. Deliberate drying reverses wetness only, never reconstructs the destroyed trap or replenishes charge/cache. No copied source reward, new prestige or automatic refill.

limits: SPD lightning reads actual water cells; no grounded/flying immunity check was found in the reviewed arc. Any such exclusion would be original.
Source Level serialization is static persistence evidence, not a verified successful save/reload or atomic failure contract.
The local graph, induction tool, latch puzzle, cache,2HP risk and earned field.focus conversion are original. Full alchemy/random generation/spell catalogue and game balance remain unreviewed.
